# Count regions based on bands
def analyze_regions(inp, sep_rows, sep_cols, target_val):
    results = []
    r_start = 0
    for i, sr in enumerate(sep_rows):
        r_band_end = sr - 1
        c_start = 0
        for j, sc in enumerate(sep_cols):
            c_band_end = sc - 1
            
            specials = [(r,c) for r in range(r_start+1, min(r_band_end+1, len(inp))) 
                                         for c in range(c_start+1, min(c_band_end+1, len(inp[0])))]
            cnt = sum(1 for r,c in specials if inp[r][c] == target_val)
            
            ri = i
            ci = j
            print(f"Band ({ri},{ci}): rows={r_start+1}-{r_band_end}, cols={c_start+1}-{c_band_end}, count={cnt}")
            results.append((ri, ci, cnt))
            
            c_start = sc + 1
